The plan: for each edited hyperparameter, I start from an all-mid baseline and flip one other hyperparameter at a time to its low or high band. That isolates single-condition interactions (55 runs). The remaining 45 runs are 2×2 factorial probes of interactions likely to matter: learning rate × batch size, depth × width (alpha × width for depth edits), and a strong-regularisation, high-learning-rate corner.
